rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose word when “gentleman” simply means a man.

example.jyutping: go2 go3 naam4 jan4 gei2 gou1

rows.note: Use this for a polite form of address or when referring respectfully to a particular man.

example.english: The gentleman at the counter paid my bill.
example.traditional: 櫃檯嗰位先生幫我埋咗單。
example.jyutping: gwai6 toi4 go2 wai2 sin1 saang1 bong1 ngo5 maai4 zo2 daan1

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean a well-mannered, refined, or charming man rather than just any man.

example.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 jau5 fung1 dou6 zan1 hai6 san1 si6

rows.note: Use this for a man perceived as effeminate or excessively fussy and sophisticated.

example.english: That gentleman is so fussy, even about having a meal.
example.traditional: 佢連食餐飯都咁多要求，真係好娘。
example.jyutping: keoi5 lin4 sik6 caan1 faan6 dou1 gam3 do1 jiu1 kau4 zan1 hai6 hou2 loeng1
